items.title: Trump says China's Xi 'seemed to like' renaming AI as super intelligence
items.summary: President Trump said Chinese leader Xi Jinping appeared to like the term "super intelligence," days after Trump said the US would officially use it in place of "artificial intelligence."

items.title: Tesla Semi: Diesel's surge gives the electric truck an opening as high prices improve the math for fleets
items.summary: Call it a victory lap rather than an official launch event for the Tesla Semi. And while not a lot of new information was revealed, there were a few tidbits of note.

items.title: Tesla's big semi truck bet is officially in motion
items.summary: Yahoo Finance's Senior Autos Reporter Pras Subramanian and The 8:30 panel with Julie Hyman and Jake Conley break down Tesla's (TSLA) opening of its Nevada factory for semi trucks.

items.title: Over 30 CEOs scored an invite to the US-China state dinner — and these 4 got a spot at the head table
items.summary: President Trump touted Thursday's long-awaited state dinner at the White House as a tough ticket, and while the Chinese business delegation was notably absent, the glittering event featured a wide array of US CEOs.

items.title: The Auto Weekly: Tesla's Semi Play, Rivian's Cheaper Model Promise And Detroit's Market Share Threat
items.summary: Tesla said high-volume Semi production is underway in Nevada, Rivian patched a camera-software defect across most of its fleet, and Ford cut F-150 shifts while Cox projected Hyundai Group to outsell Ford in Q3.

items.title: Tesla FSD Drove Over the Limit in 55% of Brussels Tests Ahead of EU Approval Vote
items.summary: Tesla Inc.’s Full Self-Driving system exceeded the legal speed limit on 55% of the Brussels road segments in a newly published test, less than two weeks before a possible EU vote that could decide how widely the system can operate...

items.title: Stock Market Today, Sept. 25: Tesla Stock Under Pressure Despite Plans to Ramp Semi Truck Production
items.summary: On Sept. 25, 2026, analysts weighed in, with BNP Paribas cutting its price target to $268, keeping investor focus on near-term earnings expectations.
